main.description: A signed, public, threaded comment on a quest / offer / delivery / other record — the negotiation and dispute trail, in the open. Mirrors the Tangled issue-comment pattern; there is no standard atproto cross-record comment lexicon (chat.bsky is centralized DMs, off-record). Public by design: only what's on the record is official. Private 1:1 is out of scope (link to Bluesky DMs if ever needed). Author is the commenter (repo owner). Written to the author's repo.

subject.description: The record this thread hangs on (a quest, offer, delivery, etc.).

replyTo.description: Optional parent message being replied to (threads).
